Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation with Multifingered Hands
via Visuomotor Diffusion
Piotr Koczy1, Michael C. Welle1,2, Danica Kragic1
Abstract— We present a framework for learning dexterous
in-hand manipulation with multifingered hands using visuo-
motor diffusion policies. Our system enables complex in-hand
manipulation tasks, such as unscrewing a bottle lid with one
hand, by leveraging a fast and responsive teleoperation setup for
